ontario-science-g4-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 4 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, and analyse actions for minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive ones
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, and analyse actions for minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive ones
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of habitats and communities and of interrelationships among the organisms that live in them
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of habitats and communities and of interrelationships among the organisms that live in them

standards.summaryText: assess the impacts on society and the environment of technological innovations related to light and sound
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impacts on society and the environment of technological innovations related to light and sound
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of light and sound as forms of energy that have specific characteristics and properties
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of light and sound as forms of energy that have specific characteristics and properties

standards.summaryText: evaluate the impacts of various machines and their mechanisms on society and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: evaluate the impacts of various machines and their mechanisms on society and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and functions of machines and their mechanisms
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and functions of machines and their mechanisms

standards.summaryText: assess the social and environmental impacts of geological processes and of human uses of rocks and minerals
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the social and environmental impacts of geological processes and of human uses of rocks and minerals
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of rocks, minerals, and Earth’s geological processes
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of rocks, minerals, and Earth’s geological processes
